sourceTitle: The Farming Wife - Blonde Brownie In A Mug
sourceText:
The Farming Wife - Blonde Brownie In A Mug
By: Amy Jeanroy
Published: Monday, May 9, 2011 - 11:43am

Ingredients




4 tablespoons flour
4 tablespoons brown sugar
Pinch of salt
2 tablespoons water
2 tablespoons coconut oil
1/2 teaspoon vanilla

Preparation

1 In a large coffee mug, spray with non stick spray 2 Combine flour, brown sugar, salt and mix with a fork 3 Add oil, water and vanilla, stir until combined 4 Microwave for 1 minute, 20-30 seconds(depends on your microwave-will need to test) 5 Let cool 1 minute and serve with whipped cream or ice cream

About


For chocolate brownies, add 2 Tablespoons cocoa and 2 teaspoons of a good bar chocolate, chopped. Press a snack sized candy bar into the brownie after it comes out of the microwave and allow it to melt for that final minute if desired(and who wouldn't desire that?)

Comments:
JustAMom

Worked out well. I substituted unsalted butter for the coconut oil.
Carmen Montanez

Me too! I melted the butter after measuring. I added chopped nuts to the recipe before microwaving, about 2 Tab.
